info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Partners-v1-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Partners API provides access to the ecosystem of partners associated with the loyalty program. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve a comprehensive list of loyalty partners, facilitating the integration of partner services and rewards into applications. Typical use cases include displaying partner information in customer-facing applications or building promotional offerings that leverage loyalty partnerships. Developers involved in loyalty and rewards program implementations will find this API essential for enhancing user engagement and satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of loyalty partners available in the system, providing essential information about each partner, enabling users to evaluate their options for loyalty programs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about loyalty partners. It allows the client to specify the criteria for filtering partners, ensuring that the response is tailored to the requested data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of loyalty partners.
